pbi_title: QC - Events - 006 - Made in China Expo

cases.title: Verify that the Made in China Expo page renders the hero, About section and side CTA card in English

steps.expected: Hero displays eyebrow "Qatari industry. Local ambition.", title "Made in China Expo", description, CTA button "Visit the Official Expo Website", breadcrumb "Home › Events"
eyebrow "About the exhibition", title "Connecting markets and business opportunities", body paragraphs visible
Made in China logo, eyebrow "Official exhibition website", heading "Explore Made in China", subtext, CTA button visible

cases.title: Verify that the Made in China Expo page renders the hero, About section and side CTA card in Arabic with RTL layout

steps.expected: Hero displays AR eyebrow/title/description/CTA, page direction is RTL, breadcrumb reads right-to-left ("الرئيسية › الفعاليات")
AR eyebrow/title/body render RTL
AR eyebrow/heading/subtext/CTA render RTL

cases.title: Verify that the breadcrumb "Home" link navigates to the homepage

steps.expected: Browser navigates to the site homepage URL

cases.title: Verify that the breadcrumb "Events" link navigates to the Events listing page

steps.expected: Browser navigates to the Events listing page (`/events`)

cases.title: Verify that the Made in China Expo page layout is responsive on a desktop viewport

steps.expected: Hero, About, side card render in the desktop 2-column layout with no overflow/clipping

cases.title: Verify that the Made in China Expo page layout is responsive on a tablet viewport

steps.expected: Sections reflow (side card moves below/beside About per breakpoint spec), no horizontal scroll, text wraps correctly

cases.title: Verify that the Made in China Expo page layout is responsive on a mobile viewport

steps.expected: Hero stacks vertically, CTA buttons remain fully tappable (min 44px touch target), side card stacks below About, no overflow

cases.title: Verify that the Made in China Expo page renders correctly in Light mode

steps.action: Load page with Light mode active
steps.expected: Backgrounds/text/CTA colors match the Light-mode Figma frame (white/light backgrounds, brand-red accents)

cases.title: Verify that the Made in China Expo page renders correctly in Dark mode

steps.expected: Page background/text/CTA colors switch to the Dark-mode token set with no unreadable low-contrast text or broken imagery

cases.title: Verify that the Made in China Expo admin form in Control Panel renders correctly in Arabic with RTL layout

steps.action: Open the Made in China Expo page in Object Authoring with the Control Panel UI locale set to Arabic
steps.expected: Field labels, tabs and buttons render in Arabic, form direction is RTL, EN/AR field entry tabs remain distinguishable

cases.title: Verify that a Site Content Editor can perform the full content lifecycle on the Made in China Expo page

steps.action: Log in as Site Content Editor; Open Made in China Expo in Object Authoring, edit a field, Save as Draft, Preview, Publish, then Unpublish
steps.expected: Each action succeeds without an Access Denied error; page reflects each resulting state

cases.title: Verify that a Site Content Author can view and update assigned Made in China Expo page content

steps.action: Log in as Site Content Author; Open the assigned page, edit the Section Body field, Save as Draft
steps.expected: Field is editable, save succeeds, no Access Denied error

cases.title: Verify that a Site Content Author is denied direct publish on the Made in China Expo page

steps.action: Log in as Site Content Author; Open the page in Draft, attempt to click Publish
steps.expected: Action is blocked; error message "Access Denied. You do not have permission to perform this action." (EN) is displayed; page remains in Draft

cases.title: Verify that a Public Visitor can view the published Made in China Expo page and use the CTA

steps.action: Open the published page URL as an anonymous visitor; Click the Hero CTA
steps.expected: Page content is fully viewable without login; CTA click redirects to the configured external URL

cases.title: Verify that a Public Visitor is denied access to the Control Panel admin URL for the Made in China Expo page

steps.action: Attempt to open the Object Authoring admin URL for the Made in China Expo page directly, unauthenticated
steps.expected: Redirected to CMS login / "Access Denied. You do not have permission to perform this action." (EN) is shown; no admin content is exposed

cases.title: Verify that a Site Content Editor can configure all Made in China Expo fields (EN/AR), preview, and publish successfully

steps.action: Log in as Site Content Editor; Fill Hero eyebrow/title/description/CTA label/URL/behavior (EN+AR), upload Hero Banner Image; Fill About eyebrow/title/body (EN+AR); Fill Side card logo/eyebrow/heading/subtext/CTA label/URL/behavior (EN+AR); Save as Draft; Preview; Publish
steps.expected: Each step succeeds; Preview shows the entered content before publish; after Publish the live public Web page (`/events/made-in-china-expo`, both `/` and `/ar/`) displays every entered field exactly as configured

cases.title: Verify that editing an already-published Hero Title propagates the new value to the public Web delivery surface

steps.action: As Site Content Editor, edit Hero Title to "Made in China Expo — 2027 Edition" on the already-published page; Save and Publish (re-publish); Load the public Web page in a fresh browser tab
steps.expected: New title "Made in China Expo — 2027 Edition" is shown, not the stale cached "Made in China Expo"

cases.title: Verify that a Draft Made in China Expo page is not visible on the public website

steps.action: As Editor, set the page to Draft and save; Open a brand-new browser context with no auth state; Navigate to the Events menu and to the direct page URL
steps.expected: Page does not appear in the Events navigation menu; the direct URL returns a not-found/standard error page, not the draft content

cases.title: Verify that an Unpublished Made in China Expo page is not visible on the public website

steps.action: As Editor, Unpublish a previously published page; Open a fresh, logged-out browser context; Navigate to Events menu and the direct page URL
steps.expected: Page is absent from the Events menu; direct URL returns a not-found/standard error page

cases.title: Verify that saving a change to the Made in China Expo page displays the Liferay generic success toast and records an audit log entry (English)

steps.action: As Editor, edit the Hero Eyebrow field and click Save; Check the toast; Open the Audit Log for this page
steps.expected: Liferay's generic success toast is displayed in English; a new audit log entry is recorded with editor's username, timestamp, and the changed field

cases.title: Verify that saving a change to the Made in China Expo page displays the Liferay generic success toast and records an audit log entry (Arabic)

steps.action: Set CMS UI locale to Arabic; As Editor, edit the Section Title (AR) field and click Save; Check the toast; Open the Audit Log
steps.expected: Liferay's generic success toast is displayed in Arabic; a new audit log entry is recorded

cases.title: Verify that the Hero CTA redirects to the external site in the same browser tab when Open Behavior = Same Tab

steps.action: As Editor, set Hero CTA Open Behavior = Same Tab and publish; As visitor, click the Hero CTA
steps.expected: The current tab navigates to `https://www.madeinchinaexpo.com`; no new tab is opened

cases.title: Verify that the Hero CTA redirects to the external site in a new browser tab when Open Behavior = New Tab

steps.action: As Editor, set Hero CTA Open Behavior = New Tab and publish; As visitor, click the Hero CTA
steps.expected: A new browser tab opens navigating to `https://www.madeinchinaexpo.com`; the original page tab remains on the Expo page

cases.title: Verify that the Hero CTA is hidden when the CTA label is configured but the redirect URL is missing

steps.action: As Editor, set Hero CTA label, leave Redirect URL empty, save/publish; Load the public page
steps.expected: Hero CTA button does not render on the delivery surface

cases.title: Verify that the Hero CTA is hidden when the redirect URL is configured but the CTA label is missing

steps.action: As Editor, set Hero CTA Redirect URL, leave label empty, save/publish; Load the public page
steps.expected: Hero CTA button does not render on the delivery surface

cases.title: Verify that the Side CTA Card button is hidden when the CTA label is configured but the redirect URL is missing

steps.action: As Editor, set Side Card CTA label, leave Redirect URL empty, save/publish; Load the public page
steps.expected: Side card renders without its CTA button

cases.title: Verify that the Side CTA Card button is hidden when the redirect URL is configured but the CTA label is missing

steps.action: As Editor, set Side Card Redirect URL, leave label empty, save/publish; Load the public page
steps.expected: Side card renders without its CTA button

cases.title: Verify that a Site Content Editor can save the Made in China Expo page as Draft

steps.action: As Editor, fill required fields, click "Save as Draft"
steps.expected: Page Status = Draft in the admin listing; page not visible on the public site (per TC-020)

cases.title: Verify that a Site Content Editor can preview the Draft Made in China Expo page before publishing

steps.action: As Editor, open the Draft page and click Preview
steps.expected: Preview renders the entered hero/About/side-card content exactly as configured, without publishing it live

cases.title: Verify that a Site Content Editor can publish the Made in China Expo page

steps.expected: Page Status = Published; page appears live on the public Web site and in the Events navigation menu

cases.title: Verify that a Site Content Editor can unpublish a previously published Made in China Expo page

steps.action: As Editor, open the published page and click Unpublish
steps.expected: Page Status = Unpublished; page disappears from the public Web site and Events menu (per TC-021)

cases.title: Verify that a Public Visitor clicking the Hero CTA is redirected to the external Made in China Expo website

steps.action: As anonymous visitor, open the published page; Click "Visit the Official Expo Website" in the Hero
steps.expected: Visitor is redirected to `https://www.madeinchinaexpo.com` per the configured open behavior

cases.title: Verify that a Public Visitor clicking the Side Card CTA is redirected to the external Made in China Expo website

steps.action: As anonymous visitor, scroll to the side card; Click "Visit the Official Expo Website"
steps.expected: Visitor is redirected to `https://www.madeinchinaexpo.com` per the configured open behavior

cases.title: Verify that a Public Visitor can reach the Made in China Expo page via Main Menu → Events

steps.action: As anonymous visitor, open the main site navigation; Click Events, then "Made in China Expo"
steps.expected: Page loads showing hero, About section, and side card
